selection: All 108 existing annotated pronunciations; no dictionary-union trials.
rule: Compare actual final syllable nucleus plus its entire coda. Preserve schwa and declared pre-R normalization. Stress is metadata, not a candidate gate. Empty coda is valid when the nucleus matches; an empty nucleus is not. Retain identical words with a repeated_word flag.
scope_note: Exact-match sound candidates only. Position labels are explicit audited scopes, not exhaustive semantic detection. Morphology and authorial intention are not inferred.
